items.title: SoFi unveils bank-issued tokenized deposit for yield-bearing crypto funds
items.summary: SoFi Bank launched SoFi Earn, a tokenized deposit paying 4.40% APY with FDIC coverage, allowing users to convert funds to stablecoins 24/7.

items.title: SoFi Launches Tokenized Deposit That Earns 4.4% and Converts to a Stablecoin
items.summary: Each SOFIE token represents $1 on deposit at SoFi Bank, earning 4.40% APY with FDIC insurance—a yield-and-protection combination ordinary stablecoins lack.

items.title: Singapore, Malaysia and Thailand central banks expand cross-border stablecoin initiative involving Ripple, Visa and Mastercard
items.summary: Malaysia and Thailand have joined Singapore's BLOOM initiative for cross-border stablecoin and tokenized deposit settlement.

items.title: South Korea to amend forex law to regulate stablecoins as payment instruments: report
items.summary: South Korea is currently developing the Digital Asset Basic Act, which seeks to establish a comprehensive framework for crypto.
